name: kami-atlas
description: Kamigotchi domain manifest: generated from the contracts, with notes, a live config reader and the Kami Domain Atlas

paragraphs: The Kamigotchi domain manifest: what every component, system, function and entity type in the Kamigotchi contracts does and means, as YAML that people and agents can read without tracing the Solidity, plus a live config reader and an interactive map (the Kami Domain Atlas).
Lives next to the game checkout: Asphodel-OS/kami/kami-atlas/ reads Asphodel-OS/kami/kamigotchi/. Repository: (private; keep it out of any public mirror, since notes hold design intent).
About 110k tokens in all (roughly: systems 34k, functions 50k, components 10k, formulas 8k, domain model 6k). Nothing is repeated: a helper used by 30 systems is written out once.
